guide.label: Guide
guide.title: How to use
guide.intro: Everything you need to spin, pick a dish and find a great place to eat it — in a one-minute read.

sections.heading: Spinning
paragraphs: There are three ways to spin:
list: Tap the SPIN button in the middle of the wheel.
Drag the wheel along its rim and let go: pull it backwards (like drawing a bow) and release, or flick it hard in the spin direction — it takes off with the force you gave it.
A small, slow drag just turns the wheel to a new position without spinning.

sections.heading: Seeing the result
paragraphs: The pointer sits on the left of the wheel. Whatever stops at the pointer is your dish.
On a computer, the result appears right next to the wheel. On a phone, it opens in a popup with a photo of the dish.

sections.heading: Finding great places nearby
paragraphs: Tap “Top spots near you”. The first time, we explain how your location is used and ask for your consent — then your browser asks for location permission.
Places come from Google Maps and only include spots rated 4.0 or higher with at least 20 reviews, ranked by rating, number of reviews and distance.
Prefer not to share your location? Choose “Search on Google Maps” instead.

sections.heading: Directions
paragraphs: Tap “Directions” to open Google Maps with your current location as the start and the place as the destination. On phones this opens the Google Maps app if installed.
Please follow traffic laws and never use your phone while driving.

sections.heading: Sound, language, install to home screen
list: Toggle sound with the “ON/OFF” control at the top.
Switch language with “VI / EN”. Your choice is remembered.
iPhone (Safari): Share → Add to Home Screen. Android (Chrome): ⋮ menu → Install app.

sections.heading: Managing the menu
paragraphs: Open “Menu” to add a dish (a photo is found on Wikipedia automatically if you don't provide one) or switch a dish off to hide it from the wheel. Switched-off dishes can be turned back on any time.
If configured, management actions require an admin PIN.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
list: Location unavailable: check your browser's location permission in Settings, then tap “Try again”.
No places found: try “Search on Google Maps”, or spin for another dish.
Wheel not showing: your browser needs WebGL; otherwise a simpler wheel is used.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data is processed when you use “Ăn gì?”, why, and your rights — under Vietnam's Law on Personal Data Protection No. 91/2025/QH15, Decree 356/2025/NĐ-CP and the Law on Cybersecurity No. 116/2025/QH15; it also meets Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) and the EU GDPR/ePrivacy rules for visitors from those regions.

sections.heading: Data controller and processor
paragraphs: Personal data controller and processor: {operator}. Address: {address}. Contact for personal data matters: {email}.

sections.heading: Data we process
list: Your device's precise location — only with your consent. This is sensitive personal data, so we only process it after you explicitly agree in the app and grant permission in your browser.
Technical data: IP address, browser type and access time, recorded in our hosting provider's server logs to run and secure the service.

Data stored on your device: a language cookie (NEXT_LOCALE, 1 year); in browser storage: your cookie/privacy choices, your location-consent record, your sound and background-music preferences (only if you turn on “Preferences”) and (for admins) the PIN for the session. See the Cookies & data page for each item.
We require no account, collect no name or phone number, and use no advertising cookies or behavioural analytics.

sections.heading: Purposes
list: Location: finding places near you, calculating distance and building directions links from where you are.
Technical data: delivering the service and preventing attacks and abuse.
On-device data: remembering your choices.
paragraphs: We do not use your data for advertising, and we do not sell or share it for other purposes.

sections.heading: Legal bases
list: Location and preferences: your consent — explicit, freely given, specific to each purpose, never pre-ticked; silence is not consent (Law 91/2025/QH15; Taiwan PDPA; GDPR Art. 6(1)(a) and ePrivacy).
Strictly necessary cookies/storage and security logs: needed to provide the service you request and to keep it secure under the Law on Cybersecurity 116/2025/QH15 (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b), (f)).
Acknowledging that you have read this policy when accepting the Terms does not replace the separate consent for each optional purpose.

sections.heading: How your location is handled
list: Your location is read from the browser when you ask for places (and have consented).
The coordinates go to our server only to relay the search to Google Maps Platform (Places API), and the results come straight back to you.
We do not store your coordinates in a database or build any movement history.
When you open “Directions”, the coordinates are put into a Google Maps link on your device.

sections.heading: Third parties and transfers abroad
list: Google LLC (Google Maps Platform): receives coordinates and the search keyword to return places; receives your IP address when you open Google Maps.

Wikimedia Foundation: dish photos are fetched and cached by our server and served to you via /api/img, so your browser never connects to Wikimedia. Only photos an admin enters from other sites load directly from those sites.
Cloudflare, Inc. (Cloudflare R2): stores and streams the background music and album covers; receives your IP address and browser details when those files load. We send Cloudflare nothing else.
Our website hosting provider: processes technical logs.
paragraphs: These parties' servers may be outside Vietnam, so using the service may involve cross-border transfers of personal data. We carry out our obligations for cross-border personal data transfers under Vietnamese law, and processing by these parties is also governed by their own privacy policies.

sections.heading: Retention
list: Location: not kept after the place search returns.
Technical logs: for the hosting provider's retention period, for operations and security only.
On-device data: until you clear the site's data in your browser or withdraw consent below.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Under personal data protection law, you have the right to:
list: Be informed about the processing of your personal data.
Give or refuse consent, and withdraw consent at any time.
Access, correct and request deletion of your personal data.
Request restriction of, and object to, processing.
Complain, denounce, sue and claim compensation as provided by law.
sections.after: To exercise these rights, contact {email}. We respond within the time limits set by law. Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.

sections.heading: Withdraw consent
paragraphs: You can change or withdraw any choice at any time via “Cookie settings” in the footer — as easily as you gave it. Location consent can also be withdrawn right here. Also turn off location permission for this site in your browser settings so the browser stops providing it.

sections.heading: Visitors from Taiwan and Europe
list: Taiwan (PDPA): at collection we tell you who collects the data, the purpose, the data categories, the period, area, recipients and manner of use, your rights, and what happens if you don't provide it (the app still works; it just can't find places near you). You may inquire, review, obtain copies, supplement or correct, request that collection/processing/use stop, and request deletion.
EU/EEA (GDPR): you additionally have the right to data portability and to lodge a complaint with the data protection authority where you live.
Send any request to {email}; we respond within the statutory time limits (Vietnam and Taiwan: typically 15–30 days; GDPR: one month).

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: The service is not directed at children. Processing a child's personal data requires the consent of a parent or guardian as provided by law.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: Connections are encrypted with HTTPS (HSTS). The site sends security headers (no framing, no content-type sniffing, limited referrers, location permission only for this site itself). The Google Maps key stays on the server and is never sent to the browser.

If a personal data breach or cybersecurity incident occurs, we will notify the competent authority (in Vietnam: within 72 hours under Law 91/2025/QH15) and affected users as required by Vietnamese and Taiwanese law and, where applicable, the GDPR.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
paragraphs: If this policy changes materially, we will ask for your consent again (the cookie settings panel will reappear). Questions: {email}.

terms.label: Terms
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By ticking acceptance in the privacy panel or continuing to use “Ăn gì?”, you agree to the terms below. Please read them carefully.

sections.heading: The service
paragraphs: “Ăn gì?” is a free tool operated by {operator} that randomly picks a Vietnamese dish and suggests places near you. Wheel results are random and for suggestion only.

sections.heading: Place information
paragraphs: Place details, ratings, opening hours and place photos are provided by Google Maps Platform. We do not own, moderate or guarantee the accuracy, completeness or currency of that information, and we have no partnership or advertising relationship with the suggested places.
Use of Google Maps is subject to Google's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Food and travel safety
list: Please check ingredients, allergens and food-safety conditions at the place yourself.
When following directions, obey road traffic law and never operate your phone while driving.

sections.heading: Dish photos
paragraphs: Dish photos come from Wikipedia / Wikimedia Commons under each author's free licence, are cached by our server, and are shown with a source link. If you own a photo and believe it is used improperly, contact {email} and we will remove it.

sections.heading: Prohibited conduct
list: Attacking, probing, overloading or interfering with the system without authorisation, or otherwise breaching the Law on Cybersecurity No. 116/2025/QH15 (in force from 1 July 2026, replacing the 2018 Cybersecurity Law and the 2015 Law on Network Information Security).
Automated scraping or abuse of the service's APIs.
Entering content that is unlawful, offensive or infringes others' rights when managing the menu.

sections.heading: Menu management
paragraphs: Menu management is for authorised people only. Managers are responsible for the dish names and photo links they enter.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: The service is provided “as is”. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for losses arising from reliance on third-party information or from temporary interruptions. Nothing here limits consumer rights under the Law on Protection of Consumers' Rights No. 19/2023/QH15.

sections.heading: Personal data
paragraphs: How personal data is processed is described in the Privacy policy; how the site uses cookies, browser storage and caching is described on the Cookies & data page.

sections.heading: Governing law and disputes
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the law of Vietnam. Disputes are first resolved by negotiation; failing that, by a competent court of Vietnam.
This does not take away any mandatory rights the law of the place where you live gives you (for example consumer and personal data rights in Taiwan or the European Union).

sections.heading: Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may update these terms; the update date is shown at the top of the page. Contact: {email} — {address}.

cookies.label: Cookies & data
cookies.title: Cookies, storage & caching
cookies.intro: This page lists everything “Ăn gì?” stores on your device, what is cached, when your location is used, and how to change your choices. We use no advertising cookies, no cross-site tracking and no analytics.

sections.heading: Summary
list: Strictly necessary (always on): makes the site work and keeps it secure — no consent needed, but you must be told.
Preferences (optional): stored only if you turn it on.
Location (optional, sensitive data): used only with your consent and your browser's permission; never stored.

sections.heading: Cookies
list: NEXT_LOCALE — strictly necessary — remembers your language (vi/en) — first party — 1 year.
sections.after: That is the only cookie. The site sets no third-party cookies.

sections.heading: Browser storage (localStorage / sessionStorage)
list: lw:consent — strictly necessary — your privacy panel choices (version, time, each category) so we don't ask again — until you clear site data or the policy changes.
lw:geo-consent — location — record that you consented to location use, and when — until you withdraw.
lw:sound — preferences — sound on/off — stored only if “Preferences” is on; deleted when you turn it off.
lw:music — preferences — the background-music album you're listening to and the repeat mode — stored only if “Preferences” is on; deleted when you turn it off.
lw:pin (sessionStorage) — strictly necessary, admins only — the menu-management PIN — cleared when the tab closes.

sections.heading: Caching
list: Your browser caches the site's code, fonts and images (standard HTTP cache) so it loads faster; dish photos are cached for up to 7 days.
Our server caches dish photos fetched from Wikimedia; this cache contains no personal data.
Place search results (which use your location) are kept only in your own browser's private cache for up to 5 minutes to avoid repeat calls; never cached on the server.
sections.after: You can clear the cache any time in your browser settings (Clear browsing data).

sections.heading: Location
paragraphs: Only when you tap “Places nearby” and have consented does the browser read your location (and it still asks permission). The coordinates pass through our server to Google Maps Platform to find places, then are discarded — never written to a database, no history. When you tap “Directions”, the coordinates are put into a Google Maps link on your device.

sections.heading: Third parties
list: Google Maps Platform: receives coordinates and the keyword for place searches (via our server); place photos load from Google's servers; when you open Google Maps, Google's own policies apply.
Wikimedia Commons: no direct connection — photos go through our server.

Cloudflare, Inc. (Cloudflare R2): background music and album covers stream directly from Cloudflare's storage, so Cloudflare receives your IP address and browser details when the player is shown or music plays. Music only starts after you tap the page and can be stopped with the sound switch or the pause button.
Fonts are hosted on this site itself (no calls to Google Fonts).

sections.heading: Server logs
paragraphs: Like any website, our hosting provider records IP address, time and the page requested to operate the service and keep it secure (Law on Cybersecurity 116/2025/QH15). Never used for advertising or profiling.

sections.heading: Changing your choices
paragraphs: Reopen the settings any time with the button below or “Cookie settings” in the footer. Turning a category off deletes what was stored for it. You can also clear this site's data in your browser settings.

sections.heading: Legal basis
list: Vietnam: Law on Personal Data Protection 91/2025/QH15, Decree 356/2025/NĐ-CP, Law on Cybersecurity 116/2025/QH15, Law on Protection of Consumers' Rights 19/2023/QH15.
Taiwan: Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA, as amended in 2025).
European Union: GDPR and the ePrivacy Directive (Art. 5(3) — non-essential cookies need prior consent).
Security practice: OWASP Secure Headers recommendations.
